# Michael Padin: custom software for Cebu businesses
> Booking, ordering, inventory and staff systems for local businesses in Cebu, Philippines.

Michael Padin is a software developer in Cebu, Philippines (UTC+8). He builds custom
systems for local businesses and works with owners directly: a free call, a fixed
quote within 48 hours paid in milestones, a working preview every week, then launch,
staff training and ongoing support.

## What he builds
- Booking & reservation systems: online booking, calendars, deposits, reminders, owner and staff dashboards
- Ordering & inventory: orders online or in-store, stock tracking, GCash, Maya or card payments
- Internal tools & dashboards: records, approvals and reports that replace spreadsheets
- Messenger & Facebook automation: Page inquiries and orders flow into the system
- Business websites + Google Maps (add-on)
- Support & maintenance

## Systems he has built
- [Hermosa Glow](https://michaelpadin.com/projects/hermosa-glow): online booking and a clinic system (calendar, counter, packages, digital consent) for a skin clinic in Carcar City, Cebu
- [MIL](https://michaelpadin.com/projects/mil): point of sale, inventory, consignment, payroll and BIR records for a Cebu shoe brand
- [Kasper Trucking](https://michaelpadin.com/projects/kasper-trucking): trip logging, delivery receipts, weekly crew payroll and client billing for a Cebu hauler
- [JimDaisy.com](https://michaelpadin.com/projects/jimdaisy): lead-generation website for two student-housing properties in California

## Background
- Image Edits (Aug 2023 – Present): full stack developer, Brisbane (remote)
- ReallyBrief, CloudNext, Techroad (2022–2023): full stack, Node.js and DevOps roles
- BS Information Technology, Cebu Technological University – Argao
